data.name: ed.title

data.value: Test email queued. Check the inbox in a few minutes; if it does not arrive, review the SMTP settings and system logs.

data.name: ed.to
data.value: To

data.value: The address the test should reach — you can use your own address.

data.name: ed.subject
data.value: Subject

data.name: ed.message
data.value: Message

data.name: ed.messageHelp
data.value: Text written into the body of the test email.

data.name: ed.send
data.value: Send

data.name: ed.pending
data.value: Sending the test email…

data.name: ed.fail
data.value: The send failed.

data.name: ed.failAccount
data.value: The chosen sender address no longer exists.

data.name: ed.failChannel
data.value: This address has no active SMTP channel; configure the outgoing server on the Email Addresses page.

data.name: ed.failInput
data.value: The send input is invalid.

data.name: ed.failDns
data.value: The SMTP host name did not resolve.

data.name: ed.failConnect
data.value: Could not connect to the SMTP server.

data.name: ed.failTls
data.value: The TLS handshake failed.

data.name: ed.failAuth
data.value: The SMTP server rejected the credentials.

data.name: ed.failSend
data.value: The server did not accept the message.

data.name: ed.failOauthConfig
data.value: OAuth2 application details are missing (client id / secret).

data.name: ed.failOauthConsent
data.value: The outgoing channel is not authorized (or the grant was revoked); authorize it on the email edit page.

data.name: ed.failOauthRefresh
data.value: The access token could not be refreshed; the provider was unreachable or refused the request.

data.name: ed.failError
data.value: An unexpected error occurred.

data.name: ed.failUnknown
data.value: The send's status could not be found; verify the outcome in the system logs.

data.name: ed.errTo
data.value: Enter a valid recipient address.

data.name: ed.errFrom
data.value: The chosen sender address no longer exists.

data.value: This email was sent to verify the RapidsolDestek outgoing mail settings. If it reached you, the SMTP configuration works.
